_doc: The schools (流派) (design/combat/spell-and-combat-spec.md §5.1, §7, §8; build item N-5.1). A school says how you cast: each spell names its school in data/spells.json (`school`), and each road takes a school (data/world/lives.json roads). schools: name, power, Spheres, casting act, and the rule it bends (only `alignment` is built). ranks: a school's ladder, with the Practice gained on its spells this life that each rank needs (`at`); a rank below the best you held in an earlier life comes `echo` times faster. outside: spells of a school that isn't this life's cost `trained` more Aether and wind-up if you hold a rank in it (or held only Initiate before), `never` more if you never trained in it, and nothing extra once an earlier life took it to `free_rank` (Adept). alignment (Astral Rite): stand still `still_s` before you begin a spell of your school and it gets `range_k` range. devices (Spark Artifice, economy spec §5.3; N-5.2): a device's charges are `base` plus its stage; a bench refills every device in one period, paying each spell's `reagents` per charge. A wizard who trained the school but isn't on its road pays `outside_extra` more of the first reagent per charge; one who never trained it pays `never_k` times the reagents (a stand-in for ready-made charges until crowns are built). `reagents` names them; `teaches` is the device the Lamplighters' bench shows anyone, with a `starter` stock once a life. combined (spell spec §8; N-5.3): a combined spell names both its schools (`schools` in data/spells.json); it unlocks once each school has reached `rank` (Master) in this life or an earlier one, plus its named spells at their stage (`needs`); it counts as either school and is never outside your school.
